text: The 1248 fix couples the Makefile MOZ_SERVICES_SYNC define to the package-manifest condition around SyncComponents.manifest. A source-level feature guard alone did not supply that preprocessor define. This is a scoped historical installer lesson: accepted source retains the Makefile define but now packages components/*.manifest; SyncComponents has no explicit entry in this manifest. Recheck the current packaging mechanism instead of copying the old entry. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending.
